title: Name the VM operations
description: You can inspect the integer codes assigned to the VM's instruction names.

steps.description: Opcode uses IntEnum and auto to assign integer values. Its first groups name stack and arithmetic operations.
The next groups name comparisons, logic operations, and variable access. These declarations supply names rather than execution handlers.
Control-flow operations use jump targets. Function and built-in names complete the opcode list.

steps.question: Which value does the display assign to the first opcode, PUSH_INT?

steps.description: The output counts 37 operations and prints the first six names and values. Defining the enum executes no VM program.
